versions.short: The bill would require the National Center for Education Statistics to set up a secure, privacy-protected data system holding information about students after high school. The system would track enrollment, progress, completion, and what graduates do afterward, as well as college costs and financial aid. It would be designed to give students and families clear, customizable information for choosing a college, and would reduce the reporting burden on colleges. The system would also periodically be matched with other federal data systems, and an advisory committee would be created to oversee it. The Department of Education would be required to provide dedicated staff for the work and report to Congress quarterly on its progress.
